title: state.json of a conductor run
description: What happened in a conductor run (<run>/state.json), written by RunStore under its lock. The root, the state of a piece and the envelope of a step are closed; values the conductor keeps as opaque records (claims, results of steps, review strategy) stay open objects. A field a later item adds is added here as an optional property of its $defs entry.

status.description: running while the conductor drives the run; the outcome of the run (finished, stopped, waiting for an answer, ...) after it.

items.description: State of each piece by its reference.

claims.description: The answer of the work source to each claim, by claim key (item-<ref> or next-<n>).

^.+$.description: Answer of a claim (ref, orch_run, submission, title, ...).

agents.description: Number of agent runs started in the run.

on_blocked.description: Effective on_blocked of the run (stop or continue).

questions.description: Questions of each piece by reference, then by question id.

executor_sessions.description: Executor session of each piece by reference (the key * for session.executor shared): the provider session, the identity it was built under and its use. Replaces the deprecated executor_session* keys.

executor_session.description: Deprecated: session of the shared executor; moved into executor_sessions when the run is resumed (SESSION_STATE_MIGRATED).

executor_session_item.description: Deprecated: piece that built the shared executor session; see executor_sessions.

executor_session_route.description: Deprecated: route label that built the shared executor session; see executor_sessions.

executor_session_route_said.description: Route label already announced by SESSION_ROUTE_CHANGED.

executor_session_task_digest.description: Deprecated: digest of the full task prompt the shared session holds; see executor_sessions.

executor_session_answers.description: Deprecated: answer keys the shared session has already seen; see executor_sessions.

review_strategy.description: Review strategy decided for the batch (mode, groups, source, ...).

^[0-9]+$.description: One group review (refs, format, error, attempts, ...).

active_s.description: Active seconds of the run, summed over its segments.

ended.description: UTC end of the last segment of the run.

last_stop.description: The stop answered by the last resume.

resume.description: Number of the resume that answered it.

limit_raises.description: Limit raises given by resume --raise-limit, in order.

items.description: One raise (key, from, to, item, at, ...).

foreign.description: Fingerprint of the changed paths outside the run taken at its start.

batch.description: Batch counters of the run (review_rounds, corrections, findings).

usage_unmetered.description: Pieces with a role run whose usage is unknown.

policy_stage_skipped.description: POLICY_STAGE_SKIPPED was announced once for the run (P3.10).

executor-session.description: The executor session of a piece (or of the run): what the provider returned, the identity it was built under (p7-design) and its use. A slot without session and with error (or neither) records why the next attempt starts fresh.

session.description: Provider session id to resume; absent after a failed attempt or one that returned none.

route.description: Route label (provider/model/effort) that last used the session.

fingerprint_digest.description: Canonical digest of the fingerprint; empty for a slot migrated from an older state.

created_at.description: UTC time the slot was created.

last_used_at.description: UTC time of the last attempt that used it (session.max_idle_s counts from here).

rounds.description: Attempts that ended with this session.

last_item.description: Piece whose attempt used the session last.

task_digest.description: Digest of the full task prompt the session holds; the delta prompt is sent only when it matches.

answers.description: Answer keys the session has already seen.

error.description: Error code of the attempt that lost the session (provider_error).

migrated.description: The slot was moved from the deprecated executor_session keys and has no fingerprint yet.

session-fingerprint.description: Identity of an executor session: another value of any field but the model and effort starts a fresh session. Empty authority_digest and isolation_home until the authority envelope and the isolation profiles exist.

worktree.description: Real path of the git top level of the project.

attempt_id.description: Attempt of the claim (absent for a shared session).

instructions_digest.description: Digest of the instructions snapshot of the run.

base.description: Revision of the first brief of the piece (absent for a shared session).

charged.description: Input tokens charged for attempts without usage (limits.unmetered charge), included in input.

stop.description: Why the run or the piece stopped (null: none).

deferred_findings.description: Confirmed findings awaiting delivery in a later correction. Evidence lives in the recorded review and triage steps.

steps.description: Steps of the current attempt by step key.

attempts.description: Earlier attempts kept aside by retry.

^.+$.description: verdict, role, route, ended, report_status, files.

orch_run.description: Run id of the piece in the work source.

outcome.description: Outcome of the piece (done, done_with_deviations, blocked, stopped, abandoned, ...).

partial.description: The blocked piece left changes in the tree.

retried.description: UTC time of the last retry.

waiting.description: The piece is blocked on questions that wait for an answer: their ids and since when (UTC). Removed by a retry.

question_ids.description: Ids of the blocking questions that wait.

since.description: UTC time the piece began to wait.

session_base.description: Revision of the first brief of the piece: the base of the fingerprint of its executor session.

stage_usage.description: Fresh usage of each logical stage (P3.10).

usage_by_agent.description: Usage receipts of each agent by attempt (P3.10: receipt.step names the logical stage).

^.+$.description: Receipts of one agent by attempt.

usage_incomplete.description: A role run of the piece reported no complete usage.

budget_over.description: Tokens used when BUDGET_OVER was first emitted.

skills_auto.description: Answer of the skills bridge for each role whose skills are ["auto"], kept once per piece (context.auto_skills).

skills_checked.description: Skills each role keeps after the selection checks, kept once per piece (context.skill_set).

deviation_ids.description: Deviation ids recorded for the piece.

followup_corrections.description: Executor rounds assigned to the ordered fix-brief backlog of a group-review follow-up. Saved before execution for replay and correction budget accounting.

items.description: Executor round owning the corresponding queued fix-brief.

correction_baselines.description: Tree marks taken before corrections, by round.

review_marks.description: Paths and their hashes seen by each review round (P2.4).

review_debt.description: Findings corrected after the last review round the wall allows (round, findings, corrected).

settled.description: Outcomes set by hand with orch conduct settle (from, to, reason, at).

dynamic_review.description: The risk of the piece turned its review on.

advice_of.description: Advice taken by the piece, by problem.

advice_fix.description: Advice text of each check fix round.

combined.description: A review correction that waits to be combined with the red checks.

checks_changed.description: The checks changed during the piece.

executor_started.description: An executor round of this run began.

expected.description: Expected outcome given by the work source.

interrupted_note.description: Interruption note of each executor step.

no_diff_admitted.description: A round without changes was admitted.

relocated.description: Runtime artifacts moved out of the tree, by step.

self_check_returned.description: Self-check results returned by the executor.

source_paths.description: Paths of the source the piece touched.

usage-receipt.description: Usage of one attempt of an agent.

usage_complete.description: The provider reported complete usage (null: unknown).

step.description: Logical stage the attempt belongs to (P3.10).

skills-auto-role.description: What the skills bridge chose for one role.

skills.description: Chosen skills (name, id, path, reason, tokens, digest, skill_md_sha256).

discoverable.description: Skills the provider may discover itself.

skills-checked-role.description: Skills one role keeps after the selection checks, and the rows left out.

step-envelope.description: Properties every step record may carry: started (a boundary persisted before the work), done (with result and verdict) or stopped (with code).

attempt.description: attempt_id of the claim when the step started.

dirty_before.description: Changed paths before a checks step.

code.description: Reason code of a stopped step.

verdict.description: One-line verdict of a done step.

step-any.description: Every step, also one of a key no family names (written by another conductor version): the closed envelope, and a done step carries a result. A started or stopped step of an unknown key reaches the recovery of resume, which stops with STAGE_RECOVERY_UNKNOWN.

oneOf.description: A done step: the result its stage returned, replayed by a resume.
A started or stopped step: no result is read.
